config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Overrides token auto-discovery. The token is generated by the Health Data AI Analyzer Mac app and normally read automatically from its sandboxed container; only set this if auto-discovery fails.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Absolute path to the local-api-token.txt file written by the Mac app. The server searches default sandbox paths automatically; only set this if auto-discovery fails.
